# StoYangu

StoYangu helps Nairobi social-media sellers create beautiful online storefronts for physical products. Sellers share one store link in Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp and other marketing. Customers browse live products and place detailed orders through WhatsApp.

## Main information
- Service area: Nairobi, Kenya
- Products supported: clothes, jerseys, hoodies, polos, perfumes, watches, beauty items, shoes, accessories, home products and other physical products
- Store setup: free
- First 30 days: free
- Ongoing maintenance: KES 300 per month after the first 30 days
- Ordering: direct WhatsApp order with product, colour, size, fulfilment and customer note
- Contact email: info@stoyangu.com
- Contact phone: 0793533683

## Public sections
- Inawork aje?: explains how a seller's marketing video brings customers to the store
- Napata StoYangu aje?: explains application, store creation and the one-minute testimonial
- Ni how much?: explains free setup, trial and maintenance pricing

Active seller storefronts are listed in the XML sitemap. Product availability and prices come from each store's live database records.
